  lda high_byte #$1234
  lda low_byte $1234
  lda high_byte $1234

  lda $1234,x++
  lda [$34],y++

.list
emit .macro
  lda #\1
  .endm
  .bank 0
  .org $8000
Start:
  emit 1
  .mlist
  emit 2
  rts

.bank 0
  .org $8000
  bne far
  lda #$1234
  lda missing
  nop
  .ds 200
far:
  rts

.bank 2
  .org $a000
foo:
  .db HIGH foo, LOW foo, HIGH foo+1, BANK foo, PAGE foo
K = $1234
  .db PAGE(K)

.autozp 1
foo = $10
  lda (foo)
  lda (foo,x)
  lda (foo),y
bar = $1000
  lda (bar),y

.bank 0
  .org $8000
  call bar
  rts
  .proc foo
  nop
  rts
  .endp
  .proc bar
CONST = 5
  lda #CONST
  rts
  .endp
